title: DWAL Bonus Shares Announcement
announcement:
This is to inform all shareholders of Druk Wang Alloys Limited (DWAL) that, during the 95th Board Meeting held on 14 October 2026, the Board proposed the issuance of bonus shares in the ratio of 1:1 (one bonus share for every share held).

Please note that the proposed issuance of bonus shares is subject to approval at the upcoming Extraordinary General Meeting (EGM) of the Company

title: EGM  Announcement of DWAL

  • Opening of the Extraordinary General Meeting (EGM).

2. Approval for Issue of Bonus Share.

title: PUBLIC NOTIFICATION
announcement:
Dear Valued Users,

Please be informed that RSEB will be carrying out an upgrade and enhancement of NDI in our production environment. During this maintenance and upgrade process, there may be temporary disruptions or unavailability of services that rely on NDI.

The affected services may experience intermittent interruptions or downtime while the upgrade is being implemented and validated. Services will remain unavailable until the NDI upgrade has been fully completed and successfully deployed in the production environment.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your patience, understanding, and cooperation as we work to improve the reliability and performance of our services.

A further notification will be issued once the upgrade is completed and the affected services are fully restored.

Thank you for your understanding and continued support.

title: Bhutan Carbide & Chemicals Ltd., Commercial Papers Series-I
announcement: Bhutan Caerbide & Chemicals Ltd., is issuing commercial papers worth Nu.324.00 million at a face value of Nu.100,000 per unit. The subscription period opens from 26 August 2026 and closes on 27 August 2026. The Commercial papers term is 330 days and offers at 5.00 % discount rate. Allotment will be done on 28 August 2026. For subscription inquiries, please contact Central Depository, RSEB at 17840507. The documents are attached herewith for reference.
